name: Cyber Rain
description: Layered glyph downpour: three parallax rain sheets are composited by scene depth, each with two drops per column rendered from a packed 4x6 glyph ROM that re-rolls as the drop falls. Every column owns one FFT bin that sets its fall rate and head brightness. The pointer bends drops aside, clicks emit bounded EMP rings, and image luminance acts as wetness that makes glyphs cling and pale.

updatedParams.name: Rain Speed
updatedParams.description: Base fall rate before the per-column band multiplier.

updatedParams.name: Density
updatedParams.description: Column pitch of the middle sheet (40–150 columns).

updatedParams.name: Glitch
updatedParams.description: Column-coherent dropout rate and glyph scramble amount.

updatedParams.name: Trail Len
updatedParams.description: Length of the fading tail behind each drop head.
